objective: Extend the W39 account context resolver into a reusable admin context layer before any governed Customer or Proof Item write.
goal: Prevent NetSuite HTML 500 failures by resolving required account setup and exposing optional admin defaults before the pilot writes.

roles.name: Context Architect Agent
roles.responsibility: Define which runtime deployment parameters are required, recommended, and optional by write role.

roles.name: SuiteScript Worker Agent
roles.responsibility: Implement the resolver in the W24 pilot Suitelet and map safe defaults to Customer and Proof Item writes.

roles.name: Regression Guard Agent
roles.responsibility: Keep main package create-disabled, keep transaction writes disabled, and ensure missing config returns JSON.

suiteletChanges: W24 pilot accountContextResolver now returns idb.account-context-resolver.v2.
W24 pilot reads currency, terms, department, and class runtime parameters as admin defaults.
Customer writer safely maps optional currency, terms, department, and class when configured.
Proof Item writer safely maps optional department and class, and still requires subsidiary and tax schedule.
Missing required context returns blocked_missing_account_context JSON before any write attempt.
deploymentChecklist: Use internal IDs for subsidiary, location, tax schedule, currency, terms, department, and class.
Set custscript_idb_default_subsidiary before any Customer write.
Set custscript_idb_default_taxschedule before any Proof Item write.
Set location, currency, terms, department, and class when the demo account or lane needs those defaults.
Keep transaction context disabled until a dedicated transaction pilot block enables it.
harnessCoverage: Blocked JSON response when subsidiary is missing.
Blocked JSON response when tax schedule is missing before Proof Item write.
Admin resolver V2 returns optional currency, terms, department, and class values without expanding writes.
Customer first and Proof Item second still create in the approved demo account harness.

nextBlock.name: Vendor Attach And Procurement Defaults
nextBlock.reason: DCC proved vendor attachment and procurement defaults are required before Proof Item writes are consultant-ready.
